messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream but it was entirely too vivid and real for me to believe that.

output.original_text: I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream but it was entirely too vivid and real for me to believe that.
output.joy: I had such an incredible out of body experience that felt like a dream, yet it was so vivid and real I can hardly contain my excitement!
output.sadness: I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream, but it felt so painfully vivid and real that I can't shake the sadness of it all.
output.fear: I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream, but it was so vividly real that I felt a chill of fear running through me.
output.anger: I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream, but it was so entirely vivid and real that it infuriates me to even consider it was just a trick of my mind.
output.surprise: I had an astonishing out of body experience that felt like it could have been a dream, but the vividness and reality took me completely by surprise!
output.disgust: I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream, but it was so disturbingly vivid and real that I feel a wave of disgust just thinking about it.
